card.name: Words leading into a treatment session
card.fires_on: Words just before a treatment or procedure noun, such as the 'ysis' in dialysis before 'sessions', or 'continuous' before infusion. It also fires on 'under' before anesthesia and on a number before 'shocks'.

modes.label: Inside dialysis and radiology words
modes.description: Fires on the end part of dialysis or radiologic, right before a session or monitoring term.
modes.example: administered at sequential dial<<ysis>> sessions by infusion or by slow intravenous

modes.label: Modifiers before administration or treatment
modes.description: Fires on small words such as continuous, each, under or as that come before a treatment, route or procedure term.
modes.example: Do not dilute or mix Insulin Aspart when administering by<< continuous>> subcutaneous infusion.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward treatment-related words, such as 'treatments', and away from bundle-like words.
card.plain: It lights up on words that lead into a treatment, session or procedure, such as dialysis or continuous infusion.
